Subject: Recap + draft MAP — Lyra Commerce / Redwood Inference

Hi Emily / Michael — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed mutual action plan (attached as Lyra_MAP_v1.xlsx). Please review and flag anything I missed.

Top pain points you shared
- Unreliable inference latency (spikes at peak traffic) causing checkout delays for personalization flows
- Token-level cost is unpredictable across current vendor stack; needs clearer unit economics for scale
- Internal compliance requirement: audit trails for inference requests and data retention controls (particularly PII redaction)

Stated goals for a successful POC
1) Stabilize tail latency for online personalization (95th percentile < 300ms)
2) Validate 10k monthly active inference calls with cost below $0.0008 per token across test workload
3) Demonstrate integration with Lyra's VPC and KMS for a production path

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level)
- Milestone 1: POC kickoff — define test dataset & success criteria — Owner: Lyra (Emily, Michael) / Redwood (Diego) — Target: 2026-11-15
- Milestone 2: Security questionnaire and data-handling proof points — Owner: Lyra procurement + Redwood security — Target: 2026-11-19
- Milestone 3: POC run (2 weeks) — Owner: Redwood infra + Lyra SRE — Target window: 2026-11-22 to 2026-12-05
- Milestone 4: Results review & go/no-go — Owner: Lyra stakeholders (Product, SRE, Procurement) — Target: 2026-12-08

Stakeholders we heard today
- Lyra: Emily Cho (Product), Michael Tan (SRE), Procurement (TBD)
- Redwood: Diego Fernandez (AE), Marissa Cole (CS lead)

Open items / asks from our side
- Please confirm your procurement contact to kick off contract/PO discussions (we can share a short MSA + statement of work as a starting point)
- Confirm any compliance artifacts you need besides the security questionnaire (SOC 2, data retention policy, etc.)
- Confirm POC dataset access and redaction requirements

Next steps
1) Emily/Michael: confirm or update milestones and procurement contact; accept or edit attached MAP (Lyra_MAP_v1.xlsx)
2) We’ll update the MAP and return Lyra_MAP_v1.1.xlsx with estimated pilot pricing and SOW language
3) Target POC kickoff week of 11/15 assuming procurement & security sign-off

If that all looks right, please reply with any edits and the best procurement contact (or loop them into this thread).

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Diego Fernandez

- Procurement contact: Sarah Kim (sarah.kim@lyra-commerce.com) — she’ll handle the SOW + PO.

On the success criteria, Product will also want an evaluation rubric for UX impact (we’ll hand a small sample of user flows).
